node.label: Phalangeal cone-shaped epiphyses
node.definition: Cone-shaped epiphyses of the phalanges of the hands or feet. Cone-shaped epiphyses (also known as coned epiphyses) are epiphyses that invaginate into cupped metaphyses. That is, the epiphysis has a cone-shaped distal extension resulting from increased growth of the central portion of the epiphysis relative to its periphery.

evidence.snippet: Geleophysic dysplasia: Phalangeal cone-shaped epiphyses (frequency HP:0040282) [TAS]
